title: 橡树资本马克斯：AI有泡沫吗？没人能下定论
speaker: Howard Marks

segments.en: Well, the main thing is, as I wrote in the last memo on the subject, Alan Greenspan used the phrase in 97. I think it was irrational exuberance.
segments.zh: 主要的一点是，正如我在上一篇相关备忘录中写的，格林斯潘在97年用过这个词。我想是“非理性繁荣”。

segments.en: And that is the definition of a bubble. We certainly have exuberance. The question is whether it's irrational.
segments.zh: 这就是泡沫的定义。我们当然有繁荣。问题是它是否非理性。

segments.en: And since nobody, in my opinion, can spec out exactly what it is that AI's been going to be doing and with what effect and with what profitability, I don't think anybody can say that it's irrational.
segments.zh: 在我看来，既然没有人能准确推断出AI究竟会做什么、带来什么影响、有多大的盈利能力，我认为没人能说它就是非理性的。

segments.en: But you have to consider the possibility. And so when you tackle AI from an investment point of view,
segments.zh: 但你必须考虑这种可能性。所以当你从配置角度看待AI时，

segments.en: you have to think about how confident you are in your judgments.
segments.zh: 你必须思考你对自己的判断有多大信心。

segments.en: And how much, like in everything else, but taken to a higher power, we have to think about how important is us to make all the money that's going to be made by the most aggressive people?
segments.zh: 而且，就像在其他事情上一样，但程度更高，我们必须思考：去赚那些最激进的人将要赚的所有钱，对我们有多重要？

segments.en: And are we willing to take on the uncertainty, which is associated with that?
segments.zh: 我们是否愿意承担与之相关的不确定性？
